verdict.rationale: Factory documents first-party Jira and Linear integrations. You can assign an issue to Factory or mention @Factory, and Droid investigates, implements, and tests the work, with sessions synchronized to Jira and Linear. However, the evidence shows ticket-triggered delegation rather than agents managing tickets, such as creating, updating, or transitioning them, and only two of the four named trackers are covered. Missing for 10: ClickUp and Monday.com integrations, documented agent-side ticket management (create/update/status changes), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly
